■ Update Details

1. New Mythic Magic Stones / Spectrumite / Spirit Treasure

1) Mythic-grade Magic Stones / Spectrumite / Spirit Treasure are the highest-tier items with far superior stats compared to Legendary-grade.

- Mythic items can be enhanced through Special Enhancement.

- Mythic Magic Stones possess higher base options and 5 random options.

- Mythic Spectrumites possess 7 random options.

- Mythic Spirit Treasures possess high base options and unique effects.



2. New System: 

1) The Altar of Sublimation is a new system where Legendary Magic Stones / Spectrumites / Spirit Treasures can be used to attempt obtaining a Mythic grade.

- The system can be accessed through the newly added NPC ‘ Enlightened Great Matron’ in the Spiritual Center.

- By using three Legendary items of the same tier along with Darksteel and Dragonsteel, you can challenge Sublimation. The higher the Special Enhancement level of the materials, the higher the success rate.

■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements

1. \[Appearance] Fixed an issue where weapon and appearance gear obstructed the screen when Lionheart characters conversed with NPCs.

2. Fixed incorrect dialogue displayed during certain Main Quests.

- Target: 'Master's Test 19 - Find Master Sarmati', 'Final Battle - Follow Sondeok'

3. \[Spirit Treasure] Fixed incorrect cooldown display of unique effects for certain Spirit Treasures.

- Target: Light's Vigor I, II; Forest's Mana I, II; Advanced Light's Vigor I, II; Advanced Forest's Mana I, II

- Change: Cooldown 10 sec → 20 sec

4. \[Spirit Treasure] Adjusted cooldown of unique effects for certain Spirit Treasures.

- Target: Forest's Silence I, II; Earth's Heat I, II; Advanced Forest's Silence I, II; Advanced Earth's Heat I, II

- Change: Cooldown 30 sec → 15 sec

5. Fixed an issue where abnormal shield values were sometimes applied when using Shield skills.

6. Restrictions on the Force Map system content have been lifted.

7. Added 4 new Spirit Treasures obtainable by Combine.

- Added to the list: ‘Martial Ascendancy Celestial Sword’, ‘Blue Dragon's Bead’, ‘Sky Passion’, ‘Ocean Pride’.

8. Corrected certain typos in the game.

Greetings, This is MIR4.



Here's what's coming with the update maintenance on Tuesday, September 2nd.



  

1. New Events

2. New System:

■ New Events

1. Starlight Memories 14-Day Check-in event

2. Black Dragon's Gift Box

3. Osher's Miraculous Fortune

4. Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event



※ Please refer to  for further details.  



■ Update Details

1. New System: 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/ccd42b23b8c4520362594b45d9248ead5059c940.png"]- The Force Map is a system that allows you to view the ruling power structure across the entire Mir continent at a glance.

- Through the Force Map, you can check the occupation status of Sabuk Castle and Bicheon Castle for all regions and servers, as well as the bidding information for Bicheon Castle Siege.



※ For more details, please refer to \[Game Encyclopedia – Force Map].



2. New Rules Added to the Valley of Life and Death.

- Improvements have been made so that character information is not revealed inside Valley of Life and Death.

3. Legendary Spirit Special Summon

- The Special Summon for the Legendary Party Leader Spirit ‘Fairy Dragon Goldflower’ will be available.

- Event Period: After the update on September 2nd,2025 ~  Before the update on September 30th, 2025



■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements

1. Fixed an issue where characters were abnormally displayed in certain cutscenes of the main quests.

2. Fixed an issue where Mana consumption increased when using the skill “Tiger Fist” of the Warrior class during Story Mode progression.

3. \[Appearance] Fixed an issue where certain textures were displayed abnormally during character customization.

4. \[Appearance] Fixed an issue where hair color changed when equipping the Fourth Anniversary Celebration Headpiece.

5. Updated acquisition routes for Mythic grade equipment.

6. \[Ranking] Improved so that when checking rankings of other classes, your own information will not be displayed.

- When checking other classes’ rankings, the message \[This is the ranking list of another class.] will be displayed.

7. Corrected certain typos in the game.

notes.title: Non-Maintenance Patch - August 20th
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/bce06d1060b63058ce38073e913bef32447dfe89.jpg"]



From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4



Greetings, This is MIR4.



We will be implementing a non-maintenance patch to fix an issue that occurred after the maintenance on August 19th.



■ Issue Details

- Fixed an issue where abnormal motions were displayed when a Fighter class character mounted the Lifeguard Jet Ski mount.



※ If the issue persists after the non-maintenance patch, please try completely closing the game client and reconnecting to the game.



We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. We will make sure this issue will not occur again.



Thank you.

■ Update Details
1. End of EXDRA Season 1
1) The first season of the seasonal token EXDRA, which ran for 24 weeks, will conclude with the update on May 27th. After a 2-week break, Season 2 will begin on June 10.
- In EXDRA Season 2, players can look forward to new Ancient Treasures and Special Magical Soul Orbs, as well as ‘Conquest Treasure’ that can be equipped to Conquest buildings.
- Detailed information about Season 2 will be provided in the June 10th Patch Notes, so stay tuned!

2) With the end of EXDRA Season 1, EXDRA1 token minting will no longer be available.
- EXDRA1 tokens already held can continue to be traded freely on PNIX DEX.
- Even after the season ends, you can still exchange their EXDRA1 tokens in the in-game Season Token Exchange Station for Ancient Equipment Boxes and Special Magical Soul Orb Boxes.

3) Materials for minting EXDRA1 tokens will no longer be obtainable.
- The minting materials for EXDRA1 tokens, ‘Red Nebula Powder’ and ‘Red Septaria’, will only be available until the June 10th Update. After that, they will no longer drop.
- The sources of ‘Red Nebula Powder’ and ‘Red Septaria’ will be gradually phased out as follows:

[Red Nebula Powder]
- Mission Scrolls and Monthly Check-in Rewards: From June 2025, ‘Red Nebula Powder’ will be replaced with ‘Blue Septaria’, which is used for EXDRA Season 2 token minting.
- Limited-Time Products: Products containing ‘Red Nebula Powder’ will no longer be sold.
- Transference Equipment Enhancement Fail Rewards: Until the June 10th Update, ‘Red Nebula Powder’ will be rewarded. However, after the update, it will be replaced with ‘Blue Septaria’.

[Red Septaria]
- Power Score Rankings (All Servers): Ranking rewards will not be distributed until the June 10th Update due to the end of EXDRA1 minting.
- Disenchant Rewards: Until the June 10th Update, Red Septaria will be rewarded. However, after the update, it will be replaced with Blue Septaria.

1) The previous WEMIX$ payment system using pWEMIX$ for in-app purchases has been replaced with the WEMIX PAY system that uses WEMIX directly.

What is WEMIX PAY?
- WEMIX PAY is a new payment method in WEMIX PLAY designed to lower onboarding platform fees for games while also offering in-game benefits for players. A portion of revenue from WEMIX PAY is used to support preserving the value of WEMIX, contributing to the sustainable growth of the WEMIX ecosystem.

◈ XDRACO Updates ◈

■ NFT Mainnet Transition
1. MIR4 NFTs to Transition from Tornado Chain to WEMIX3.0 Mainnet
- The environment for minting, storing (in-game use), and trading MIR4 NFTs will transition to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet.
- All previously minted NFTs before this update must be transitioned to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet.
- Even if your NFT was previously transitioned from Tornado to WEMIX3.0 after the November 2024 NFT Marketplace update, it must be transitioned again in accordance with this mainnet transition.
- Transition Effective Date: May 13th, 2025, 10:00 (UTC+8)
※ Mainnet Conversion work may be delayed depending on the maintenance progress.

[NFT Transition Guide]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/2cf60081a645c57022515ec7c81718723f2fb7dd.png
- Tansition Target: All NFTs that are minted (Tornado and trading Mainnet NFTs)
- Transition Method:
  1) Connect to WEMIX PLAY.
  2) Log in to WEMIX PLAY.
  3) Check NFTs through: My Wallet > NFTs > Owned NFT
  4) Select the NFT you want to transition.
  5) Click "NFT Transition".

※ NFTs minted after this update will not require a separate transition.
※ No gas fees will be charged during the transition process.

2. MIR4 NFT Marketplace Guidelines
- NFTs minted after this update can be transferred between wallets once sealed.
- NFTs that remain unsold on the Marketplace must be canceled from sale and transitioned to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet before relisting.
- NFTs that are not transitioned after the update can no longer be newly listed for sale.
- On the old Tornado Chain-based Marketplace, only sale cancellations and NFT retrievals will be possible going forward.

※ Please refer to [Pre-Notice: 2025, MIR4 NFT Transition] for further details.

■ MIRAGE

Changes to MIRAGE Usage Following NFT Transition to WEMIX3.0 Mainnet
- Mirage Chain Conversion Implementation Schedule: May 14th, 10:00 (UTC+8)
- Before the implementation of the Mirage Chain Conversion, only Tornado Chain NFTs can be used in the MIRAGE content.
- To register an NFT to your MIRAGE Roster, it must first be converted to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet, just like in-game NFTs.
- If you currently have NFTs registered to ‘My Roster’ that were minted on the Tornado Chain, you can continue using them for activities such as entering Hidden Valley Capture, MiraX enhancement, and recharging Vigor without converting them to the new mainnet.
- However, if you seal a Tornado Chain NFT that is already registered in ‘My Roster’, you must convert it to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet in order to register it again to your roster.

※ If any errors occur due to continued use of Tornado Chain NFTs after the update, please follow the provided instructions to convert them to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet before proceeding.

■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements
1. [Missions] Improved target quantity for gathering-related missions.
 - The required quantities for gathering-related missions (Plant, Ore, Energy, Darksteel, Box, and Void Orb) have been reduced, allowing for quicker mission completion.
2. [Craft] Fixed an issue where Dragon Materials would incorrectly display as 0, even when Dragon Materials were available, during equipment crafting.
3. Fixed an issue where the name and description of the buff granted by the Healing Tonic item were displayed incorrectly.
4. Fixed an issue where the effects of Mythic items among the obtainable items in the Black Dragon's Battlefield were not displayed.
5. Fixed various in-game typos.

- Mythic Equipment can be enhanced up to Stage 20.
- Mythic Equipment is not destroyed upon enhancement failure, but the enhancement stage may decrease.
- Each Mythic Equipment possesses a powerful unique effect, which can be changed using the Manifest Ability feature.

2) New  Martial World Master NPC
-  Martial World Master can be found in the Spiritual Center.
- Using the Awaken function from  Martial World Master, you can awaken Legendary Equipment into Mythic Equipment.
* Equipment Awakening consumes Tier 4 Legendary Equipment that has been enhanced to Stage 15, Divine Dragon's Soul, Mythic Equipment Materials (Eternal Steel/Coldsteel/Jade), and Dragonsteel as materials.

- The Invoke function of  Martial World Master allows you to craft the Divine Dragon’s Soul.
* Invoke lets you combine 3 Legendary Dragon Materials to attempt crafting a Divine Dragon’s Soul. Upon failure, you will receive Divine Dragon’s Promise Points. You can obtain a Divine Dragon’s Soul either by succeeding in Invoke or by collecting 5 Divine Dragon’s Promise Points.

3) New Mythic Equipment Crafting Recipes

1) The Ancient Box is a special treasure chest object that can be opened using an Ancient Key.

1. Boosting World Server Closure
- The Boosting World Server, which was introduced to invigorate the MIR continent, will be closed after 12 weeks of operation.
- All Boosting World Server exclusive events and Yiun’s Boosting World Mission Scroll will end.
- Characters transferred from the Boosting World Server will now have full access to all content, just like characters on regular servers.

1) The maximum expandable slots for the Private Warehouse have increased.
- Maximum Expandable Slots: 500 -> 999
2) Private Warehouse Expansion Tickets have been added.
- You can expand your Private Warehouse slots using Gold or the Private Warehouse Expansion Ticket.
*Even if you use the Private Warehouse Expansion Ticket items, you cannot expand your Private Warehouse beyond the maximum expandable slots.
- Private Warehouse Expansion Tickets can be purchased from the Shop.

3. New Auto-Promote System
- A new system has been added that allows Special Magical Soul Orbs and Ancient Treasures to be promoted automatically.
- You can set a Promotion Goal level, and the system will continuously attempt Promotion until the goal is reached.
* Special Magical Soul Orbs can be auto-promoted up to Lv.8, and Ancient Treasures up to Rare Tier 4.
- Promotion will continue until the Promotion Goal level is reached or the required materials run out.
- Materials used for Auto-Promote are the same as those used for regular Promotion, and all consumed materials will be destroyed regardless of the result.

4. Mystic Meow Haeryeong Special Summon
- Legendary Party Leader Spirit ‘Mystic Meow Haeryeong’ Special Summon has begun! 
- Special Summon Period: After the February 18th, 2025 Update ~ Before the March 18th, 2025 Update

- Newly Added Legendary Spirits: Thunder Divine Dragon Toril, Diviner Octy, Soothing Healer Haeryu
*Mystic Meow Haeryeong, Lookout Luna, and Celestial Guardian Eldra will not be obtainable from the Legendary Spirit Stone Restoration Box, Legendary Divine Dragon's Spirit Mystery Box, or Combine Spirit Stones.

1. Fixed an issue where the Taoist’s Moonlight Wave and Moonlight Orb skills hit more times than intended during Story Mode.
2. Improved the Request list to display Requests that cannot be progressed due to unmet prerequisites.
- If the prerequisite conditions are not met, the quest cannot be accepted, and a message stating "Requirements unknown." will be displayed.
3. Fixed an issue where some objects in [Elite] Underground Jail in the Sabuk Area spawned in locations that made them impossible to collect.
4. Improved certain Enhancement Stones by adding a [Use] button, allowing players to go directly to the corresponding Enhance screen.
- Affected Items: Transference Equipment Enhancement Stones, Divine Dragon's Dragon Artifact Enhancement Stone/Ancient Treasure Enhancement Stone
5. Fixed various in-game typos.

■ Update Details
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/70472bcf6f82eac039ccbfd61678259a976371fa.png1. New Growth Content: Descent of Divine Dragon
1) Descent of Divine Dragon is a new growth content feature that allows you to unlock Pressure Points using Dragon Materials and Dragonsteel, granting your character various stats.
2) There are six Pressure Points, each requiring different materials for unlocking.
- The materials to unlock the six Pressure Points are [Dragon Scale, Dragon Claw, Dragon Leather, Dragon Eye, Dragon Horn, Dragon Sphere].
- Dragon Materials can be substituted with the ‘Divine Dragon’s Key’ item, which can be acquired via Mana Dismantle or purchased from the Shop.
3) Higher-grade materials unlock higher-grade Pressure Points, with varying numbers of stats granted:
- Rare Grade: 1–3 Random Stats
- Epic Grade: 3–6 Random Stats
- Legendary Grade: 6–10 Random Stats
* Unlocking grants stats of grades C ~ B.
4) You can re-unlock Pressure Points to reassign their grade and stats.
- Re-unlocking requires the same materials as the initial unlock and cannot use lower-grade materials.
* Re-unlocking grants stats of grades C ~ B.
5) Stats assigned to Pressure Points can be readjusted using Aspiration.
- Materials required include [Aspiration’s Pledge, Dragonsteel, Copper]. Aspiration’s Pledge can be obtained via Mana Dismantle.
- The more stats assigned to a Pressure Point, the more materials are required.
- The number of stats assigned to a Pressure Point does not change during Aspiration.
* Aspiration grants stats of grades C ~ SS.

※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia - Descent of Divine Dragon] for further details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/f1b87988ca3717c2eeda0e68ca4b874e41223ae1.png2. New System: Mana Dismantle
1) A new system that allows you to dismantle Rare or Epic-grade equipment or Mana Beads to obtain various growth-enhancing items.
2) Mana Dismantle has six stages for each grade: Uncommon 1–6 / Rare 1–6 / Epic 1–6. 
3) The Dismantle Stage is determined by the Grade/Tier/Enhancement Level of the materials, with higher levels yielding better rewards.

※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia - Character] for further details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/2f35d38acc4d61920de36c899be74ce574b44860.png3. New System: Dragon Artifact Benediction
1) Dragon Artifact Benediction is a new system that activates additional stats for parts equipped with Black Dragon or White Dragon Artifacts.

7. Ancient Equipment, Special Magical Soul Orbs, and Red Nebula Powder Probability Improvements and Additional Red Septaria Source Added
1) The probability of receiving Rare-grade equipment and Special Magical Soul Orbs from Ancient Equipment Boxes and Special Magical Soul Orb Boxes has been increased.

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Here's what's coming with the update maintenance on Tuesday, November 26th.

◈Update Summary◈
1. New Growth Server: Boosting World Server
2. New Events
3. New Seasonal Token: EXDRA
4. New Equipment: Ancient Treasure
5. New Magical Soul Orb: Special Magical Soul Orb
6. New Field: Hydra's Depths
7. Transition from PLAY Wallet to WEMIX PLAY Login
8. NFT Transactions Limited to Mainnet Chain and Sealed Server Unsealing
9. New Legendary Party Leader Spirit: Mystic Meow Haeryeong
10. New Mounts
11. New All Servers Power Score Ranking System

[November 26th Patch Note Details]

■ Boosting World Server
1. The Growth-Focused Server  is now available! 
- The Boosting World Server is a new server focused on rapid growth, available for a limited time.
- In the Boosting World Server, you can enjoy various benefits like pop-up stores and support passes without needing to worry about World Content such as (e.g., Wayfarer Travel, Expedition, etc.) so that you can focus on your character’s growth and progression.
- In addition to the events held on regular servers, exclusive events tailored for the Boosting World Server will also be available, allowing players to take full advantage of growth benefits.
- Server Schedule: November 26th, 2024 Update - February 18th, 2025 Update

※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia - Boosting World Server] for further details.

■ New Events
1. Sweet 7-Day Check-in
2. Piggio's Sweet Chestnut Exchange Shop
3. Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event

※ Please refer to [Notice - Event Round-up] for further details.

■ Boosting World Server Exclusive Events
- These events are only available on the new Boosting World Server.
1. Boosting World Welcome 7-Day Check-in
2. Yiun's 28-Day Accumulated Check-in I
3. Ruler of the Boosting World
4. Boosting World Mail Reward
5. Yiun's Boosting World Scroll
6. Boosting World Mission Pass

※ Please refer to [Notice - Boosting World Event Round-up] for further details.

■ Update Details
1. New Seasonal Token: 
- EXDRA (Expansion of DRACO) is a seasonal token designed to enhance the value of existing tokens.
- EXDRA tokens can be used to craft powerful equipment or traded freely on PNIX DEX.
- The first season of EXDRA tokens runs from November 26, 2024 to May 13, 2025 (24 weeks).
- The token for EXDRA Season 1 is named EXDRA1.
- EXDRA1 tokens have a fixed issuance limit and can be obtained through various methods, such as in-game crafting, Hydra Staking, and Play Token purchases.
- EXDRA Tokens can still be used or traded freely after the season ends.

※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia - EXDRA] for further details.

2. New Equipment: 
- Unlike existing equipment, Ancient Treasures are powerful new equipment that grow sequentially through the ‘Promote’ system.
- Ancient Treasure can be upgraded from Uncommon grade to Mythic grade, with more powerful unique effects unlocked as they progress from Epic grade onward.
- You can craft boxes containing Ancient Treasure in the EXDRA Token Exchange Shop.
- The Ancient Treasure that can be obtained by exchanging EXDRA1 tokens is the ‘Ragnos's Ring.’

※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia - Ancient Treasure] for further details.

3. New Growth-Oriented Magical Soul Orb: 
- Unlike regular Magical Soul Orbs which have EXP, Special Magical Soul Orbs use a ‘Promote’ system, leveling up by using identical Special Magical Soul Orbs as materials. 
- Special Magical Soul Orbs can be upgraded from Common grade to Mythic grade, with more powerful unique effects unlocked as they progress from Epic grade onward.
- Special Magical Soul Orbs can be crafted from boxes available in the EXDRA Token Exchange Shop.
- The Special Magical Soul Orb that can be obtained by exchanging EXDRA1 tokens is ‘드라카잔 마령주’.

※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia - Special Magical Soul Orb] for further details.

5. PLAY Wallet Login Discontinuation and Transition to WEMIX PLAY Login
- The PLAY Wallet login service, previously used in-game for MIR4 and the XDRACO page, will be discontinued.
- All systems requiring the previous PLAY Wallet login service will be transitioned to the WEMIX PLAY App login system.
- Please refer to the guide below to migrate your existing PLAY Wallet to the WEMIX PLAY App.

※ Please refer to [Guide to Changing Wallets] for further details.

6. NFT Transactions Restricted to Mainnet Chain and Unsealing Limited to the Sealed Server
1) Character NFT Transactions Limited to Mainnet Chain
- MIR4 character NFTs can now only be traded via the Mainnet Chain.
※ MIR4 NFTs are based on the Tornado Chain and must remain on the Tornado Chain for creation and use. Switching to the Mainnet Chain to sell your NFT will incur a gas fee (WEMIX).
- The WEMIX PLAY Marketplace (beta), which supported Tornado Chain NFT transactions, will no longer allow new registrations or transactions for Tornado Chain NFTs.
- To trade NFTs listed on the WEMIX PLAY Marketplace (beta), you must retrieve them, convert them to the Mainnet, and sell them via WEMIX PLAY.

※ Please refer to [Mainnet↔Tornado Chain Conversion Guide] for further details.

2) NFT Unsealing Restricted to the Sealed Server
- The server where the NFT was last sealed will be designated as the ‘NFT Server Info’.
- Purchased character NFTs can only be unsealed on the server specified in their ‘NFT Server Info’.
- If Wayfarer Travel is used to change the server before sealing, the NFT's server will be updated accordingly.

1) All Servers Power Score Ranking Details
- Overview: The All Servers Power Score Ranking system measures the power score of all Dragonians across all servers and determines rankings to distribute rewards accordingly (this includes the Boosting World Server).
- Ranking Criteria: Rankings are calculated based on power score across all servers, from 1st to 10,000th place.
- How to Check Rankings: Rankings can be viewed in the [Official Forum > Power Score Ranking] section.
- Reward: The ‘Glorious Red Septaria Box’ which contains materials for crafting EXDRA1 tokens.

The Dragon Artifact category is divided into ‘Black Dragon’ and ‘White Dragon’, and the Dragon Artifacts that can be equipped are different for each category.
- 'Black Dragon' Dragon Artifact Category Equipment: Majestic Scepter, Majestic Cape, Majestic Crown, Majestic Seal, Majestic Tome
- 'White Dragon' Dragon Artifact Category Equipment: Ornate Blade, Heavenly Bell, Incense Burner, Crescent Jade, Bronze Mirror

3. New ‘Dragon Artifact Inheritance’ System
Through ‘Dragon Artifact Inheritance’, you can transfer a Rare ~ Legendary grade Dragon Artifact to a ‘Black Dragon Artifact / White Dragon Artifact’ of the same grade.
- The inherited ‘Black Dragon Artifact / White Dragon Artifact’ has higher stats than the existing Dragon Artifact.
- The inherited ‘Black Dragon Artifact / White Dragon Artifact’ maintains the existing enhancement stage and enchantment properties.
- Even if a previously tradable Dragon Artifact is inherited, the ‘Black Dragon Artifact / White Dragon Artifact’ obtained through ‘Dragon Artifact Inheritance’ cannot be traded.

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We’re excited to share the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, July 9th, 2024.

◈Update Summary◈
1. Spooky and Chilly Exorcism Log Events
- The blazing summer is here again, but fear not, Dragonians! We've prepared three thrillingly cool events to help you beat the heat.
2. ‘Dragonians' Spirits, the Chosen Companions!’ Community Events
- Show off your favorite Spirits in two new community events!
3. Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event 
- The challenge continues with the Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge event! Don’t miss this opportunity for a chance to obtain a Legendary Spirit Treasure!
4. New ‘Spirit Portrait Collection’ Event
- Earn special rewards with the new ‘Spirit Portrait Collection’ event by collecting ‘Spirit Portraits’!
- With the addition of the new ‘Spirit Portrait Collection’ event, the previously ongoing ‘Portrait Collection’ event will be changed.
5. New Legendary Party Leader Spirit: ‘Diviner Octy’
- Make waves with ‘Diviner Octy’, the stellar new party leader Spirit that conjures an all DMG reduction spell for your party when you attack!
6. Max Enhancement Increased for Legendary Grade Equipment and Dragon Artifacts
- Legendary Equipment and Dragon Artifacts have shattered their limits, reaching unprecedented power levels!

[July 9th Patch Note Details]

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR 4.

After the May 14th Update Maintenance, we confirmed an issue with unsealing NFT Characters. To fix this issue, we implemented a non-maintenance patch today, at 14:30 (UTC+8).

After the non-maintenance patch was implemented, the issue has been fixed.

■ Issue Details
- Issue of error code 9001 appearing and being unable to connect to the game when Unsealing a character that was loaded from an NFT.

※ If the issue persists after the non-maintenance patch, completely close the game client and reconnect to the game.

We sincerely apologize for this issue. We will put in all our efforts into making a stable gaming environment and make sure to not have this problem occur again.

Thank you.

Greetings, This is MIR4.

[Main Updates]

◈In-Game Updates◈
1. New Fields in Mirage Ship
- New Mirage Ship areas 'Layer 3 World 2' and 'Layer 3 World 5' have been discovered! With this comes an increase to the maximum level, expansions to Conquest, Constitution, and Inner Force, along with formidable new field bosses and enticing crafting recipes!
2. New ‘Collection Codex’ System
- ‘Collection Codex’ is a new system for characters Level 10 and above that allows you to obtain additional stats based on Codex Completion.
- A new ‘Collection Codex Ranking’ system based on the completion of the ‘Collection Codex’ will provide additional buffs based on your ranking.
- The first collectible item in Collection Codex is ‘Magical Soul Orb’, with more items to be added through future updates.
3. New ‘Spring's Scent’ Events

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We’re excited to share the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, March 19th, 2024.

[Main Updates]

◈In-Game Updates◈
1. New Portal Content: 'Valley of Life and Death'
- Step into the Valley of Life and Death, where every Dragonian stands equal on the battlefield!
2. World Boss ‘ Drakazan’
- Stay vigilant and alert as the World Boss ' Drakazan' sporadically wreaks havoc in the Domination Server!
3. New Transference Equipment: ‘Wu Yeogi's Gourd’
- Harness the potent strength of 'Wu Yeogi's Gourd' and experience its might!
4. ‘Awaken! Book of Secrets II: Arise, Heroes’ Events!
- ‘Tome's 7-Day Check-in II’ Event
- ‘Osher's Miraculous Fortune II’ Event
- ‘Clan Coin Exchange Shop’ Event
- ‘Ruler of the Valley of Life and Death’ Event
5. Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event
- The Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event makes its triumphant return!
6. New Mission Scroll: 
- Empower your journey with Wu Yeogi’s Mission Scroll, offering a swift path to growth and abundant rewards!

[March 19th Patch Note Details]

◈In-Game Updates◈

■  Portal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/a02af4d37225ff2c6539c82b26f6c191ed6d2697.png
● New Portal Content: 'Valley of Life and Death'
 - 'Valley of Life and Death' is a large-scale team PvP content where Dragonians from all servers within each region can engage in battles with a normalized playing field.

● 'Valley of Life and Death' Schedule
- 'Valley of Life and Death' will progress in biweekly seasons, with the Valley opening twice daily, for a total of 14 times per season.
- During the opening of 'Valley of Life and Death,' characters of Level 100 or higher can participate up to 3 times a day.
- The first season of 'Valley of Life and Death' will take place from March 25th (Mon) to March 31st (Sun).

● 'Valley of Life and Death' Rules
- 'Valley of Life and Death' will be conducted with 50 players, 5 randomly assigned to each team, for a total of 10 teams. If 50 players are not recruited by the end of the Valley's recruitment time, the game will be automatically canceled.
- All participants in 'Valley of Life and Death' will have the same character (Level 100) and skill level (Tier 8), and their stats will be fixed according to their class.
- In 'Valley of Life and Death,' you can earn activity points by killing boss monsters, enemy characters, resurrecting allied characters, absorbing Stat Beads, and destroying the Cintamani Stone to grow your stats.
- A devastating thunderstorm called the ‘Great Lightning Circle' that inflicts continuous damage will occur in 'Valley of Life and Death' as time progresses, and its range will expand.
- 'Valley of Life and Death' lasts for 12 minutes, and at the end of the game, the team rankings will be determined by combining the score earned by team members.

● 'Valley of Life and Death' Rewards
- If you have obtained at least the minimum individual score at the end of 'Valley of Life and Death,' special reward items will be given based on the team ranking.
- The player with the highest score at the end of 'Valley of Life and Death' will receive the MVP reward.
- At the end of 'Valley of Life and Death,' the individual's score in the Valley will be accumulated in the season ranking, and special rewards will be given based on the season ranking at the end of the season.

● New 'Valley of Life and Death' NPC
-  Soul of Life and Death
- Soulguiding Badge can be obtained as rewards from 'Valley of Life and Death'.

※ All items claimed from this event cannot be traded.
※ Dragonians must manually claim their daily check-in rewards from the event page each day.
※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia - Valley of Life and Death] for further details.

■ World Boss -  Drakazan
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/7e4551141c41b710e1a38a31ef4f20a757c8467b.png
● Every week, excluding weekends, the World Boss ' Drakazan' will appear on a random day.
- The World Boss ' Drakazan' will appear in a dormant state every Monday at 2:00 AM. and will become active for battle on a random day, excluding weekends, when the dormant state is lifted (you can meet him in the 'Black Dragon Abaddon' in the Domination Server - Black Dragon Valley.)
- The appearance of ' Drakazan' can be confirmed through Drakazan's status on the Domination Server entry screen. It will change to a Standby state at 4:10 AM. on the day the dormant state is lifted, and then changes to a Vanquished state at 9:10 PM.
- Notification messages will be displayed in the home server and the Domination Server when the World Boss ' Drakazan' appears.
- The 'Black Dragon Abaddon' where the World Boss ' Drakazan' is summoned can accommodate up to 450 people, and if entry is not possible, you will be placed in a waiting queue.

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We are distributing the hotfix data to implement the fix of the issue confirmed after the February 20th Update Maintenance.

■ Patch Details 
- Fix the issue where a designated field terrain of the Red Moon Valley 2F was penetrated

- Achievement progress can be made based on the number of failed attempts to enhance Transference Equipment, and you can obtain failed enhancement Transference Equipment as a reward.

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

A non-maintenance patch has been applied to fix the issues confirmed after the update maintenance on September 19th.

■ Patch Details
- An issue with the 'Bowling Club's Heavy Bowling Ball' outfit of Darkist that displays the bowling ball with an abnormally big size upon using skills.

We will always do our best to provide a stable service.

Thank you.

Greetings, This is MIR4.

[Main Updates]

◈In-Game Updates◈
1. Sabuk Clash Update
- Prepare for an epic region-based war to claim the throne of the Sabuk Emperor and prove your clan's might in this ultimate battle for power and glory!
2. Rule the Territory
- Rule your territory with unrivaled power as Emperor of the Sabuk Castle!
3. Party Leader Spirit: Red Eyes Lucy
- Check out MIR4’s newest Legendary Spirit which grants an additional buff for the party when summoned by the Party Leader.
4. Special Sabuk Clash Events!
- Come celebrate the release of Sabuk Clash and earn a bounty of rewards by participating in our exciting range of events!
5. Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event
- Back by popular demand, the Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event is here to offer you another chance to summon an elusive Legendary Magic Stone!

[March 21st Patch Note Details]

◈In-Game Updates◈

■ War
● Sabuk Clash - The Grand Scale of War is Here!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/e940c75e27044737f26992b49e24093496c89008.jpg
- Sabuk Clash is a region-based war among Kings and their clan from all servers, who will then assemble in the Domination Server to fight for the title of Emperor of Sabuk Castle.
- Sabuk Clash will last for 3 weeks and consist of 3 Gateways under 1 weekly-cycle (Attack Route, Castle Gate, and Sabuk Castle). Clans who succeed in engraving the Monolith will be qualified to proceed to the next stage.
- The clan leader of the clan who wins the final round (Gateway 3) will be crowned as Emperor of Sabuk Castle.
- The Emperor rules over the Sabuk Castle Territory and has the rights to adjust the tax rate, declare Imperial Decrees, assign Imperial Titles, and distribute Prizes.
※ If no Monolith has been engraved from the 1st and 2nd Sabuk Clash Gateways, the Sabuk Clash will automatically end and the title of Emperor will remain vacant until a King and their clan is victorious in Sabuk Clash.
※ Sabuk Clash Gateway 1 will begin on Sunday, March 26, 2023 and the following stages will take place a week after (7-day cycle).

■ Territory
● The emperor rules the Sabuk Castle territory under his or her reign.
- The Emperor who has won the Sabuk Clash will have a right to rule the Sabuk Castle Territory.
- The Emperor can use features referred to below.

1) Appoint Position
> The Emperor can appoint a government position to king clan members to aid your ruling.
2) Use Tax of Sabuk Castle Territory
> The Emperor can manage taxes accumulated in Sabuk Castle Storage.
3) Adjust Tax Rate
> The Emperor can adjust the tax rate of each currency charged from home servers under your reign.
4) Prizing
> The Emperor can select a specific character to award him or her.
5) Imperial Title
> You can select a clan in the region where the Emperor belongs and grant an imperial title to the clan.
6) Emperor exclusive mount
> Only the Emperor can purchase or ride the mount ‘Sabuk Destrier’ .
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/af7077ecdc2e18aefaeb2af1e5fd7338e5088b6a.png
7) Exclusive Symbol
> An exclusive symbol will be available for Emperor's Clan only.
8) Imperial Decree
> The Emperor can select a specific server in home server to declare or lift the Imperial Decree.
9) Emperor's Utterance
> Messages from the Emperor will be shown on all servers in the region.
10) Proclamation
> Bicheon King : Only Bicheon King can use this feature to distribute mails to the server where the King belongs.
> Sabuk Emperor : Only Sabuk Emperor can use this feature to distribute mails to the region where the emperor belongs.

※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia > [Sabuk Clash] for further details.

notes.title: [Notice] Announcing the official Chronicle roadmap of upcoming changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/f17c370c6607941cc08e7baace9d4127fcfa0589.jpg

Announcing the official Chronicle roadmap of upcoming changes intended to improve the gameplay experience of all Dragonians of MIR4.

MIR4 has become much more than a game. It is now a lifestyle to many Dragonians from all over the world. Looking back over the history of MIR4’s service, we can appreciate how various aspects of the game and its economy have changed over the past year intended to create the best possible gameplay experience for Dragonians from all over the world. Many newly implemented changes of the past resulted in the birth of innovative content such as HYDRA to generate a means of player-owned economy protected from bots and multiboxing abusers who continue to disrupt the fair gameplay environment of our Dragonians in MIR4.

Despite these efforts, however, there are continuous disturbances caused by abusers that negatively impact the economy within the game and deprive Dragonians of the benefits that are entitled to them. Therefore, we have planned a grand initiative to significantly reform in-game contents that are directly associated and closely aligned with the economy as well as the competitive interactivity between players for power in MIR4. This initiative is designed to modify core economic systems centered around Darksteel and to further evolve the state of player-centric contents that drive the need for competition and power which will create a much more responsive and enjoyable environment for all Dragonians. 

We refer to this initiative as ‘The Great Resistance’. There are many major changes that are part of the initiative which can be summarized into two significant phases; (a)restoration of economic control for Dragonians, and (b)reigniting the spirit of conquest. 

The first phase is to introduce several content modifications as key components for economic systems revamp through the July 12th maintenance update, which will focus on increasing the difficulty of access to Hidden Valleys and Darksteel mines especially for bots and multiboxing abusers. Following this update, rework on the Altar of Darkness will take place on Aug 9th designed to enforce more responsibility upon those who rule over the server as well as the Hidden Valleys by incorporating a significant loss of Darksteel tax income. This update will encourage the idea of “Noblesse Oblige” by setting clear guidelines on the relationship between responsibilities and circumstances to the powerful leaders of each server in MIR4.

The second phase will focus on revitalization of the game’s main theme- ‘from my battle, to our war’. Each Dragonian tells their own unique story that begins with adventuring in the vast world of MIR. Many have engaged in numerous fierce battles to become rulers of the Hidden Valleys and the Bicheon Castle. Recent cross-server contents have sparked cooperation and strife among neighboring servers through Expedition and Bicheon Heist. 

On Aug 23rd, a major change will take place through merging of servers. This is a preparation phase intended as a "Prelude of Conquest" prior to the beginning of the greatest war yet to be unveiled in the history of MIR4. While the majority of servers will remain intact, certain servers will become merged in preparation for the launch of 'Conquest Servers' scheduled to be released in September of 2022. Once 'Conquest Servers' become live, upto 16 servers will wage war in a single interconnected server to be crowned the mightiest among all. This will not only reignite the spirit of conquest in all Dragonians but will also redefine the magnitude of 'our war' in the phrase- 'from my battle, to our war'.

In addition to merging of servers, brand new NFT servers will also be introduced where creation of new characters will not be allowed and only the mightiest and bravest Dragonians with existing character NFTs will be invited to write yet another grand story free from bots and multiboxing abusers. 

The authors of the MIR4 legacy are the Dragonians. Together, we will write yet another great masterpiece in the land of MIR. Let us rid the land of those who violate our gamer’s code of fair gameplay. Let us prevail and rise above them all in ‘The Great Resistance’.

■ Altar of Darkness
● Altar of Darkness is new competitive content that players can participate in through Expedition. The Natives (Defense) and the Expedition members (Offense) get to commence a war over the Altar of Darkness, which is summoned on each Valley 4F, every day from 21:00 to 22:00.
- Altar of Darkness gets summoned to the center of each Valley 4F. (Icon will be displayed on the minimap)
- Players can participate in this content through Expedition.

● Winning Condition of the battle of Altar of Darkness
- Expedition members (Offense) : Destroy Altar of Darkness summoned on each Valley 4F.
- Natives (Defense) : Protect Altar of Darkness summoned on each Valley 4F.

● How it works
- The battle of the Altar of Darkness divides players into Offense and Defense.
Attack : Expedition members (Players who traveled from other servers through Expedition)
Defense : Natives (Players whose original server is the current server)
Battle Schedule : Every day, from 21:00 to 22:00 (Based on Regional Server Times)
- The Darksteel mining rate of the Valley will decrease by 20% if the Altar of Darkness is destroyed. The destroyed Altar of Darkness will be resummoned in the same place at 20:00, 3 days after the last destroyed date, and the battle may restart from 21:00.3rd day from the destruction, and the battle may restart from 21:00.

● Status of the Altar
- Protected : The altar is unsealed but is currently unavailable to attack.
- Sealed : The altar is in sealed status and unattackable.
- Summoning : The altar is currently getting resummoned after being destroyed from the previous battle (20% Decreased Darksteel mining rate)
- In battle : The altar is in vulnerable status and is available for battle.

● Rewards of Altar of Darkness Battle

▶ Natives (Defense)
- (Success) Protected the Altar : No change in Darksteel mining rate.
- (Fail) Failed to protect the Altar (Altar is destroyed) : Reward box(es) can be obtained, but the Darksteel mining rate of the valley will decrease.
▶ Expedition members (Offense)
- (Success) Destroyed the Altar : Reward box(es) can be obtained, and the Darksteel mining rate of the valley will decrease.
- (Fail) Failed to destroy the Altar : No change in Darksteel mining rate.

Greetings, This is MIR4.
These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, April 5th, 2022.
 
====================================

[Main Updates]
◈In-Game Updates◈

1. New content : Expedition
- ‘Expedition’ will enable players to temporarily travel to other servers each day from 21:00 ~ 01:00.

2. Regional Clan List

====================================

[Apr. 5th Patch Note Details]

◈In-Game Updates◈

■ Expedition
● ‘Expedition’ is a new content that allows players to temporarily travel to other servers each day from 21:00 ~ 01:00. (Regional Server Times)
- Only characters above level 70 that have joined the top 20 Clans of the server can access the ‘Expedition’ content.
- ‘Expedition Participation Ticket’ is required to take part in the ‘Expedition’ content which can be purchased through the Shop with Gold. Dragonians may access the 'Expedition' menu through ‘Transfer’ and temporarily transfer to another server by using their tickets.
- Accessible areas during the expedition to other servers are limited to Outpost, Training Cave, 4F of all Labyrinths and Valleys, Shackling Abaddon, Crimson Abaddon, Black Flame Abaddon, Duel Arena, and 7F Magic Square & Secret Peak.
- Dragonians participating in the Expedition will initially have 5 'Lives'. Each time they are defeated by enemies in battle, one of their 'Lives' will be expended. Once all 'Lives' have been depleted, Dragonians will be unable to leave their Outpost to rejoin the battlefield.
- Dragonians who are defeated while inside Magic Square or Secret Peak will automatically revive from the respective respawn point. However, once they no longer have expendable 'Lives' left, they will respawn in the Outpost regardless of the time remaining in Magic Square or Secret Peak.
- Maximum 20 ‘Expedition Tokens’ can be earned per day by defeating local players of the Expedition server.
- Maximum 20 ‘Raid Tokens’ can be earned by local players per day by defeating ‘Expedition Members’ who have traveled from another server.
- Earned tokens can be exchanged with various items such as Rare Noirsoul Herb Box, Epic Blue Dragon Statue, and ‘Water of Life’ which grants additional life. They can be exchanged by visiting  Right Josan and  Left Josan located in the Bicheon Castle and Outpost.
※ Characters that have already participated in an Expedition CANNOT travel to another server by Wayfarer Transfer until the Expedition period of the day ends.
※ Expedition applies a travel restriction to servers outside of your own region. (Ex. ASIA11 > ASIA 21 is not allowed)

● 2 Token Shop NPCs will be added with the addition of the Expedition content.
-  Right Josan
-  Left Josan
- Both NPCs will offer same types of items but will accept different currency

[Exchangeable Items - Price]
Rare Noirsoul Herb Box - 10 Expedition Token/Raid Token
Water of Life - 2 Expedition Token/Raid Token
Epic Blue Dragon Statue - 15 Expedition Token/Raid Token
Ancient Dragon’s Epic Equipment Box - 300 Expedition Token/Raid Token
Epic Magic Stone Box - 100 Expedition Token/Raid Token
Epic Spirit Treasure Box - 100 Expedition Token/Raid Token
Epic Material Box - 2 Expedition Token/Raid Token

Epic Adamant Potion - 10 Expedition Token/Raid Token

Epic Life Elixir Box - 10 Expedition Token/Raid Token

■ Clan
● Clan List
- Clan List will now show clans from all adjacent servers within the same regional group.

● ‘Unattackable Clan’ function will be added.
- Clan members with Diplomacy permission can register or unregister clans in the 'Unattackable Clan' menu
- Clans in other servers but in the same region can also be registered as ‘Unattackable Clans’.
- Allied clans will be registered automatically and they will also be unregistered if the alliance gets disbanded.

■ Portal
● Magic Square 7F and Secret Peak 7F will be added.
▶Magic Square 7F
- Minimum required Power Score : 105,000
- Monster levels : 115~130
▶ Secret Peak 7F
- Minimum required Power Score : 108,000
- Monster levels : 120~130

■ Territory
● Territory tax income display method will be changed.
- Previous : Real-time income
- Post Change : Total income of the day before
※ Displayed income will reset at 00:00 (UTC+8) each day.
 
■ Crafting
● Summon Ticket Exchange Token event will end
- All craftable event items including Summon Tickets will be discontinued at the end of the event period.
- Crafting Merchant : Gwon Chuyoung

■ In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements
1. A confirmation alert message will now appear before registering an item in Clan Shop.
2. Fixed the visual issue of the opponent's 'Evade' skill.

◈DRACO Updates◈

■ HYDRA
● HYDRA Payment will be implemented.
- HYDRA Payment is a new system implementation that allows players to purchase packages available through the in-game shop using HYDRA besides traditional payment methods.
- All packages sold via cash (USD) will become purchasable using HYDRA in the PC version.
- The Oracle system will determine the exact and proper value of HYDRA as a currency in the in-game shop.

＊What is the Oracle system?
Oracle system is a new system that essentially determines the value of HYDRA as a currency in the in-game shop based on the data sourced from the Trinity algorithm, which maintains the tri-sphere equilibrium within the ecosystem of MIR4.

● Important reminder
- WEMIX ID must first be linked to your game account in order to access the HYDRA Payment system.
- Purchased packages will be sent to the in-game Storage.
※ HYDRA Payment is only available in the official PC version.
※ Purchases made using HYDRA Payment are non-refundable.
※ Please refer to [HYDRA Payment] in our Game Encyclopedia for more information

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/d179500baa6d28d7baa0f1757473103c43c6727b.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, December 14th, 2021.

================================================================================
[Main Updates]

◈In-Game Updates◈

1. New 'Phantasia' Area will be added.

2. New Raid 'Crimson Dragon Nest' will be added.

3. New Boss Raid 'Forsaken King' will be added.

4. New Clan Expedition 'Blue Thunder Dragon' will be added.

5. End-of-the-Year Event 'Yiun's Pot of Wishes' will begin.

6. Zoetrope Achievement will be added.


◈DRACO Updates◈

1. Item source will be displayed in XDRACO items.

2. Confirmation Mail will be sent after the XDRACO item is traded on EXD.
================================================================================

[December 14th Patch Note Details]


◈In-Game Updates◈


1. New Area - Phantasia
● Phantasia regions: Phantasia Desert, Ant Hole, Sabuk Province, Sabuk Castle Underground Jail, Desert Road, Phantasia Labyrinth 
- New Main Quests, Mission and Requests added

● Maximum level expansion to Lv 130
- Maximum Conquest levels will be expanded to Stage 17. To level up to Lv 130, the Tower of Conquest must be promoted to Stage 17.
- Maximum tier for constitution and inner force will be expanded to 13 and 12. 
(Muscle Strength Manual/Nine Yin Manual/Nine Yang Manual)

2. New Raid - Crimson Dragon Nest
● New Raid 'Crimson Dragon Nest' will be added. (Boss Lv 130)
https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2021/12/a6a570ea17a77dac8ba7da6b29f26574.png

3. New Boss Raid - Forsaken King
● New Boss Raid 'Forsaken King' will be added. (Boss Lv 120)
https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2021/12/f3fa2cf17d17b6f8d5be1752739956a5.png

4. New Clan Expedition - Blue Thunder Dragon
● New Clan Expedition 'Blue Thunder Dragon’ will be added. (Boss Lv 115)
https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2021/12/20f2e6d9fe75744cd377141707770acf.png

5. Special End of Year Event - 'Yiun's Pot of Wishes'
● First Event : Yiun's Daily Wishes
- Event Period : December 14th ~ Before January 11th Update
- You can earn various items through 14 days of Attendance.
※ Event rewards can be claimed by clicking the Firecracker icon on the top left corner of the screen.

● Second Event : Yiun's Letter of Wishes
- Event Period : December 28th 00:00 ~ January 10th 24:00 (UTC+8)
- You can obtain 'Letter of Wishes' items through Hunting/Event Shop purchases and exchange for various growth items including Time-Limited Event Codex.
- Maximum of 1000 'Letter of Wishes' can be obtained per day.
- 'Letter of Wishes' can be exchanged for wanted items from NPC  located in major cities. (Bicheon Castle/Snake Pit/Spiritual Center/Phantasia Desert)
https://file.mir4global.com/live_global/community/editor/2021/12/64522e7d893b9bec974ba8b1ca305a6f.png

● Special Codex - 'Bell of Wishes'
- 'Bell of Wishes' Codex badge can be obtained from the 'Coffer of Wishes' item exchanged by 'Letter of Wishes'.
※ 'Letter of Wishes' will not be dropped in Portals, or from monsters under 20 Level difference.
※ 'Letter of Wishes' will be dropped until January 10th of 2022, 24:00 (UTC+8) and will be deleted on January 17th, 24:00 (UTC+8).
※ Please refer to [Event - Yiun's Pot of Wishes'] for more details.


6. Zoetrope Achievement

● Zoetrope Achievements will be added.

8. Codex Favorites
● You can now register Codex as favorites to find and complete them with priority.

◈DRACO Updates◈

1. XDRACO item info improvements
● Source information will be added on XDRACO item details.
- Item Craft Date
- Craft Serial Number

2. 'EXD Sale/Purchase Complete' Mail will be sent on the completion of EXD trade.
● The XDRACO trade notification mail will both be sent to the seller and buyer.

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, November 30th, 2021.

================================================================================
[Main Updates]

◈In-Game Updates◈

1. 'Wayfarer Travel' will be added.
- Wayfarer Travel is a new system that enables players to transfer their characters between Servers, Worlds, and Continents.

2. 100th Day Anniversary Event - ‘Divine Dragon Descending’ will begin.

3. “Horyong’s Monthly Attendance Event” will begin.

4. New Mission Scroll 'Master: The Gathering' will be added.
- This new mission scroll will boost your character’s Gathering, Mining, and Meditation.

5. 2 new spirits will be added.

6. All Guest Account game access will be restricted.
- Guest Accounts must first be linked with a Social Network account in order to regain access to the game.


◈DRACO Updates◈

1. EXCHANGE BY DRACO(EXD) service will become live through exd.xdraco.com
================================================================================

[November 30th Patch Note Details]


◈In-Game Updates◈


1. New System - 'Wayfarer Travel'

■ 'Wayfarer’s Pass' is a new item which will be added to enable players to transfer between Servers, Worlds, and Continents.

■ Requirements for 'Wayfarer Travel'
- Level 40+ Characters can travel to other Servers, Worlds, and Continents by using 'Wayfarer’s Passes'.
- Destination Server, World, or Continent can be selected through the Wayfarer Travel menu.
- All requirements listed on the Wayfarer Travel checklist must first be met.
- Players must wait 5 days after transferring their character to their destination server in order to use Wayfarer Travel again.

■ Number of Wayfarer’s Passes required for Wayfarer Travel
- Traveling within the same World: 1x Pass (ex. From ASIA 11 to ASIA 14, within ASIA1)
- Traveling to a different World of the same Continent : 2x Passes (ex. From ASIA 1 to ASIA 2)
- Traveling to a different Continent : 3x Passes (ex. From EU to ASIA)
※ Wayfarer’s Pass can be purchased from Shop with Gold.
※ For more details, refer to [Game Encyclopedia - Wayfarer Travel]


2. 100th Day Anniversary Event - ‘Divine Dragon Descending’

■ Event 1 : The Joy of Growth
- You can earn ‘Divine Dragon's Blessing’ and various items through 14 days of Attendance.
※ Please refer to [Event - The Joy of Growth] for more details.

■ Event 2 : Divine Dragon's Blessing
- Players can obtain a special ticket that can be used to receive a free combination result item. (Highest grade obtainable through the ticket is based on your highest Combination attempts.)
- You can access [Divine Dragon's Blessing] in the event menu.
※ ‘Divine Dragon's Blessing’ Ticket can be used until December 20th 23:59 (UTC+8), and it will be deleted after the scheduled period.
※ Please refer to [Event - Divine Dragon's Blessing] for more details.

■ Event 3 : The Joy of Gathering
- Event Period : November 30th(Tue) ~ December 14th(Tue) until scheduled maintenance update
- Details : Items obtained through hunting or Shop purchases can be exchanged for various reward items from Event NPC located in major cities.
※ Please refer to [Event - The Joy of Gathering] for more details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/1c587c7bb4bb5d97492672a0f8439e802bc43474.png

1) Hoppy's Arcadia Express
- Event Period : Surprise rewards will be sent to in-game mailboxes on December 3rd (Fri).
- Schedule : 9:00, 12:00, 19:00 (UTC+8)
2) Surprise UP & DOWN
- Event Period : November 30th (Tue) ~ December 14th (Tue) until scheduled maintenance update
- Copper summons in the Shop will only cost 100 copper for the duration of the Event period.
- Gold summons will yield double mileage points for the duration of the Event period.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/cccd3f53e79bffacb9e82ac7ec44df655f0603f4.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

These are the details of the update scheduled for Tuesday, November 16th, 2021.


[Main Updates]

◈In-Game Updates◈

1. New content 'Castle Siege' will be added.
2.'Zoetrope' system will be added.
3. 'Mystical Piece' system will be added.
- Mystical Piece is a new system used to further develop your character’s growth.
4. Duel Arena will be added in Bicheon Castle.
5. Changes on Gathering/Mining/Crafting Darksteel

◈DRACO Updates◈
1. XDRACO Sealed Box will be added.


[November 16th Patch Note Details]

◈In-Game Updates◈

1. New content - 'Bicheon Castle Siege'
■ ‘Bicheon Castle Siege’ will be added.
- To participate in the Bicheon Castle Siege, your clan is required to research level 1 'Defense Formation' under the Clan Warfare subsection in Clan Tech. Once your clan completes the necessary requirement to participate in Bicheon Castle Siege, Clan Funds can be used to bid in the Bicheon Castle Siege Tender.
- Clan with the highest Tender bid will be designated as the defender during Bicheon Castle Siege, and the clan with the second-highest Tender bid will be the designated besieging clan.
- Bicheon Castle Siege will be held once every 4 weeks on Sunday, 22:00 to 23:00 (1 Hour) server time.
- Each of the defending and besieging clans can have up to 150 members (300 members in total) participate in the Bicheon Castle Siege.
- Siege Weapon Craftsman (NPC) on both the defending and besieging clans’ territory can summon special Siege Weapons through the use of Clan Funds.
- Defending and besieging clans will engage in a fierce battle for up to 60 minutes. The defending clan must protect the monolith from being destroyed for 60 minutes, while the besieging clan will be required to penetrate the defending forces and destroy the monolith before the time runs out.

■ Siege Eve
- 'Castle Siege Eve' will be held from Monday to Saturday of the week that the Siege Tender is being held.
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be obtained and used to cheer for the clans that are participating in the Bicheon Castle Siege.
- 'Kingdom Coffer' can be exchanged by collecting and using 'Drums of Victory’.
- Maximum of 60 Kingdom Coffers can be acquired per character during the event period.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' can be registered in the time-limited codex after acquiring the item.

2. Zoetrope
■ Horse Emblem will be added.
- Horse Emblem can be obtained per advertisement videos watched and you can watch maximum of 20 Ads per day.
- Horse Emblems can be acquired by each character but are character-bound.
- The balance can be seen in the upper side of the shop tab.
- Token obtained by zoetrope views could be used to buy materials from Zoetrope exchange station.

■ Watching Ads
- 'Zoetrope View Rewards' can also be earned by watching 10 advertisements per day other than 'Horse Emblem'.
- Rewards can only be obtained by clicking the 'View Rewards' icon located in the upper right corner which will disappear after the reset on 00:00
※ Reset time will be based on Regional Server Times. 
    ASIA(UTC+8)/INDIA(UTC+6)/MENA(UTC+3)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
- 'Uncommon Zoetrope View Rewards' can be obtained by using Zoetrope View Rewards.
- Additional Zoetrope View Rewards with Rare, Epic grade can be obtained as an achievement by stacking the View Count.

- It will be more difficult to interrupt someone who is already gathering/mining.
※ Resistance on CCs such as Knockdown/Stun will increase, and mining won't be canceled unless CC’d.
- You will not be able to mine Darksteel if you have an internal injury.
※ Internal injury stacks up when you die and the stacks vary depending on the PK Alignment of your character.
※ There are 3 levels of internal injuries, Minor Injury/Major Injury/CRIT injury and you won't be able to mine Darksteel if you have a CRIT injury. 
※ You will get a CRIT injury if you have 20 stacks of internal injury.
- Mining amount will decrease on negative PVP status (Bad, Evil, Outlaw).
- Smelting or exchanging DRACO, or crafting a Darksteel box will be restricted if a character has less than 500k Darksteel.

6. In-game bug fixes & gameplay improvements
- Translation feature will also be added in the Mail > Account tab.
- Chat copying feature will be added.
- Duration period will be displayed on buff items instead of Cool time.
- Fixed an issue of not being able to see some character's skill effects.
- Fixed an issue of not being able to move during the quest in Spiritual Center.
- Fixed an issue of the unmatching appearance of some monsters during the quest in Viperbiest Plain.

◈DRACO Updates◈

1. XDRACO Sealed Box
■ XDRACO Box Crafting will be added.
- XDRACO Box Contains: Glittering Powder, Life Elixir, Identification Scroll, etc

- The sealed item won't be usable in the game after it’s been moved to XDRACO Warehouse, except for trading through the XDRACO market. (Can be reused after unsealing)

1. New Class 'Arbalist' will be added.

2. New system 'Class Change' will be added.
- Class Change is a new feature enabling players to change into a different class while maintaining the character’s growth progression and achievements.

◈In-Game Updates◈

1. New Class - Arbalist
- New class Arbalist will be added.
   Arbalist is the only ranged physical damage class in MIR4, an agile, battle-hardened assassin

2. Class Change
- Class Change system enables you to switch between different classes while maintaining the original character's Level, Constitution, Inner force, and server-based codex.
- The Class Change system is available from Level 50, and different class types can be unlocked using copper and gold.
- All growth progression stats and inventory items will remain even when switching classes. However, class-specific skills will not be carried over and equipment will become unusable.

Further details can be checked in our Game Encyclopedia - 'Class Change'

3. Solitude Training
- Solitude Training is a feature where players can further elevate their character’s efficiency in PvE and PvP environments through 4 specialized groups of vessel training. (Conception, Governing, Thoroughfare, Girdle Vessels)
- Solitude Training is available from Level 70.
- Each type of vessel training group is made up of 8 ability slots which enhance specific character stats. There are 32 types of stats in total, which can be enhanced up to rank 10 by using energy and resources.
- Source to gain required items for Solitude Training
   Snow Panax and Oil(Uncommon to Epic) can be obtained from Magic Square/Secret Peak 4th floor 
   and above.
   Snow Panax/Oil can drop from field monsters.
   Rare Noirsoul Herb can drop from Field/Elite/Labyrinth/Hidden Valley area types.
- Additional stats can be gained by reaching higher levels of enhancement.
- Solitude Training consists of 3 types of possible outcomes; Success, Fail, and Tangled Inner Force. Each time you are affected by the Tangled Inner Force, Enhancement levels can decrease by up to 3 ranks. 

Further details can be checked in our Game Encyclopedia - ‘Solitude Training’.

4. Special boss 'Crimson Emperor Utukan'
- Crimson Emperor Utukan: Lv. 130
- Utukan is approximately 10 times stronger than Snake Valley's 4th floor boss.
- Utukan’s lair can be found in the ‘Crimson Abaddon’ located on the 4th floor of the Snake Hidden Valley.
- Spawn Time : Every Friday 22:00

notes.title: Update Preview - September 2nd, 2021
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/de9430626ca03685fda88a6394fc61753ea18758.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings Dragonians,

First of all, we would like to thank all Dragonians for your passion and love for MIR4.

It has now been 6 days since our official launch and we want to share a preview of our very first update.

This update is currently scheduled for September 2nd, 2021. With this update, we want to address the issues we've been gathering from the community feedback as the most urgent fixes.

Besides the mentioned below, we will share the detailed patch notes through another announcement. 

- Fix MP Potion (Large) effects
- Fix DRACO DERBY calculation error
- UI improvements for various languages
- Fix unresponsive game launcher after reaching 100% installation (PC version)
- Fix game bugs

We will continue to monitor and gather feedback from our Dragonians through the MIR4 Discord, Facebook, and Customer Support Center about game improvement suggestions, bug reports, hacker reports, and more to ensure we continue to provide a fun game service. Please join the MIR4 official Discord and Facebook if you haven't already.

Discord - https://discord.gg/c3TxjUtyRG
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mir4global

Thank you!
